name: Slaughter House Gang
description: A prominent 19th-century street gang in New York's Fourth Ward, known for violent muggings and murder. They lured victims into local dive bars to be robbed and sometimes murdered. If a victim refused, the gang would follow them until a woman at a window dumped a bucket of ash to blind them, after which the victim was attacked, pushed into a cellar, robbed of everything including their clothes, and thrown into the street. The gang was led by George Leese, a known river pirate, mugger, and organizer of illegal bare-knuckle prize fights in the Fourth Ward. The Slaughter Housers remained dominant in the neighborhood until police drove them out following the American Civil War.
